title: Swap the Pulse Laser I for a Pulse Laser III at Ironlight Crossroads, LHS 1140 (fit with replace): the division's weapon, three at a time
note: 2026-11-22 00:24 UTC (Apophis): the first live swap of `fit` with `replace` (requests.log ENT-290, ENT-304, ENT-308; route_run.py FIT_REPLACE). Orders ENT-059, block APOPHIS: weapons fitted, prey the division can beat; rule F17: a new module on one ship first. Why this laser: the one-ship test hunt-test-acubens-bulwark-pl3 killed 2 bulwarks (hull 95, above the one-ship gauge of 79) in 13.3 minutes at 100 percent hull (runs.jsonl, 2026-11-21 20:52 UTC). Why here: 13,436 cr x 20 at Ironlight Crossroads (data/market/784309214f105860a16a0c100a70eb14.json), against 22,085 x 2 at Central Nexus (00:24 UTC). LHS 1140 is lawless, six jumps from home, a station of the Ironlight Combine with public access (fit-ice-harvester-lhs-1140): an empty hold (rule F3). Once per pilot, max_pilots 1 until its RESULT line is read; then lifted to the drones that hunt prey of 80 to 100 hull. 2026-11-22 04:15 UTC (Apophis): the tests hold three results and more (rule F37): with a Pulse Laser III two drones killed deuteron slugs (85 hull) 3 a run in 6 runs, slag tortoises (90 hull) 3 a run in 2 runs and bulwarks (95 hull) 2 a run in 3 runs, the lowest hull 100 percent in every run (table runs, hunt-test-*-pl3, 2026-11-21 20:52 to 2026-11-22 03:41 UTC); the Pulse Laser I had killed no slag tortoise in 2 runs. So the division's weapon: max_ships 1 -> 3, max_pilots 1 -> 20, the asks of Ironlight Crossroads (13,436 x 20, book read 04:11 UTC); requires.ask keeps a ship from an empty trip. Paid from each pilot's own wallet (rule F12; min_credits 30,000 keeps it above F7): 20 x 13,436 = 268,720 cr, about 10 percent of the division's credits (fleet money, Military 2,709,285). 2026-11-23 09:50 UTC (Apophis): lifted for the role (rule F17, parallel batch; F37: 20 runs, every one fitted): max_ships 3 -> 5, max_pilots 20 -> 34, min_credits 30,000 -> 17,000. At 30,000 the fit opened to almost no drone: the wallet sweep holds a drone at 30,000 (F7), and the buy of 13,436 cr (the ask at Ironlight Crossroads, 14 units, table books 09:36 UTC) plus the 3,000 floor is 16,436. Two Laser III ships were lost overnight and fly Laser I again (ship files).
